node.title: Re^3: How to read multiple files from multiple zip archive.
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [Mjpaddy],

So what code have you tried?

For getting a list of files, [doc://glob] may be helpful. And the [mod://Archive::Zip] documentation says: "One can use [mod://Archive::Zip::MemberRead] to read the zip file archive members as if they were files."

Regards,
-- Hauke D
